body.description: Create one pixel-art tactical dungeon scene in the exact visual language of the supplied CHARACTER SHEET: chunky dark charcoal outlines, compact large-headed tiny fantasy figures, restrained sage/olive greens, dusty mauve/violet, blue steel and copper accents, simple 2-3 tone pixel clusters. Reinterpret these character designs into volume; do not copy the sheet layout or white backdrop. SAME ELEVATED ISOMETRIC CAMERA for FLOOR AND ALL CHARACTERS. Symmetric diamond tile TOPS width:height 4:3 (like 128x96), NOT flat 2:1. Oblique shoulders, visible top of heads/helmets and side of torsos/shields, bodies facing diagonal grid axes; NO flat front-facing sprites. Six small figures, separated, each occupies ONE clearly bounded tile. Both soles directly touch the middle of that tile, feet wholly inside its edges, never straddling seams. Leave ample visible floor around feet; no hidden foot positions behind props. NO pedestals, discs, plinths, little personal platforms, rings or selection markers. Only tiny contact shadows. Continuous floor, simple matching environment, crisp stepped pixels, no smooth painting, no blur, no text, no UI. Show entire room with dark neutral margin. Landscape 4:3 canvas. SCENE: Broken octagonal courtyard made from a square isometric tile grid with clipped corners; creeping ivy on rear walls, fallen arch to one side. Six figures: ranger, shield knight, staff mage, plant humanoid, mushroom goblin and horned beast. CORRECTION TO FIRST RESULT: Preserve the broken octagonal courtyard and figure locations, but TURN the knight, mage and mushroom figures, including their HEADS, TORSOS, SHOULDERS and BOOTS, visibly 45 degrees toward diagonal grid axes. Show substantial top-of-helmet/head and side-of-torso planes, with faces seen obliquely, not frontally. Make every figure share the floor camera, with both feet fully inside one tile. Keep a continuous floor, no personal base.

style_image.usage_description: Character sheet is STYLE and character design reference only. Use its chunky outlines, compact large-headed fantasy proportions, muted colors and few-tone pixel clusters. Reinterpret each character in true elevated isometric view, with visible top and side surfaces. Do not copy white background or frontal sprites.

reference_images.usage_description: Use the exact symmetric 4:3 diamond TILE TOP geometry; characters stand with both feet centered on a single tile, without pedestal or selection disk.
Use this continuous 4:3 isometric board projection and common elevated camera for both room and characters. Ignore annotations, isolated example tiles, grass colors and UI lettering.
FIRST GENERATED SCENE is a layout and color reference ONLY. Preserve recognizable room composition. Apply all correction instructions to characters or bridge; do not repeat the first result flaws.
